github.notes: Workflow initially failed due YAML colon in inline pip command; fixed with folded YAML scalar. One test fixture accidentally contained a complete unit XOR, corrected to isolate residual behavior. Earlier failure history remains in GitHub.

algorithm.representation: Each complete sign-mask parity group selected from original CNF becomes one XOR equation; every other original clause remains verbatim in residual CNF; source indices account for every source clause exactly once.
algorithm.native_solver: CryptoMiniSat 5.15.0 with native XOR for extracted blocks and ordinary CNF for residual
algorithm.source_limits: n<=5000, clauses<=30000, literal occurrences<=120000; complete sign-mask XOR support width<=6
algorithm.tests: Adversarial and deterministic-random small formula exhaustive assignment equivalence; tiny mixed SAT and UNSAT original-model/safe-classification smoke
